thread:
nina (People Ops): Reminder: review window closes Friday 11:59pm PT. Managers should complete sign-offs by Thu 5pm PT. Exceptions need the extension form.

omar (Eng Manager): For clarity: new hires within 30 days get automatic 1-week extension?

nina (People Ops): Correct. Hire date <=30 days before close = automatic 7-day extension once logged in the form.

tara (IC): My manager is in EMEA and I'm in PST. Will timezone cause problems for the manager sign-off deadline?

nina (People Ops): System cutoff is PT. Managers should plan to sign by Thu 5pm PT in their local time equivalent. If timezone blocks you, use timezone option on extension form.

leo (Hiring Ops): Heads-up: bulk upload API is live for managers with >10 directs. Template available on docs: /api/reviews/bulk-upload. Tag rows with "uploaded_by_manager" when submitting.

omar (Eng Manager): Is there a field to mark contractors as not eligible?

nina (People Ops): Yeschoose Worker Type = Contractor and set Eligibility = Not Eligible or Manager Summary for 31-90 days.

audit-bot: :lock: Any edits after submission create an audit entry (actor + timestamp).

tara (IC): If a calibrator has a conflict, what's the recusal process?

nina (People Ops): Use the "Recuse" button in Calibration UI; an alternate calibrator is auto-assigned. Add a short note.

omar (Eng Manager): Office hours?

leo (Hiring Ops): Quick help drop-ins: Thu 9:00-10:30 PT and Fri 15:00-16:30 PT (https://cal.redwood.com/reviews-help).

nina (People Ops): Final checklist: submit self by Fri 11:59pm PT, managers sign by Thu 5pm PT, attach 1-2 artifacts or link, use extension form if needed. DM reviews@redwood.com for manual fixes. Good luck!
